in_arabic.name: راكب
in_arabic.meaning: الراقب، الحافظ، العليم، من أسماء الله الحسنى
in_arabic.long_meaning: راكب هو من أسماء الله الحسنى، ويعني الذي يراقب و يحافظ على كل شيء، وهو من الأسماء التي وردت في القرآن الكريم، و هو اسم الفاعل من راقب يراقب فهو راقب، ومنه قوله تعالى:  الرَّاقِبُ الْعَلِيمُ، ويحمل هذا الاسم معاني الالتزام والحماية والرعاية.

in_urdu.name: راکب
in_urdu.meaning: راقب، حافظ، عالم، اللہ کے خوبصورت ناموں میں سے ایک
in_urdu.long_meaning: راکب اللہ کے خوبصورت ناموں میں سے ایک ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے محافظ، نگہبان، اور سب کچھ جاننے والا۔ اس نام کی اصل العربية سے ہے اور قرآن کریم میں بھی اس کا ذکر آیا ہے، جیسے کہ: الرَّاقِبُ الْعَلِيمُ۔ یہ نام ذمہ داری، حفاظت، اور دیکھ بھال کے مفہوم کو ظاہر کرتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: राकिब
in_hindi.meaning: राकिब, हाफिज़, आलिम, अल्लाह के सुंदर नामों में से एक
in_hindi.long_meaning: राकिब अल्लाह के सुंदर नामों में से एक है, जिसका अर्थ है रक्षक, प्रहरी, और सब कुछ जानने वाला। यह नाम अरबी मूल से है और कुरआन में भी इसका उल्लेख है, जैसे कि: الرَّاقِبُ الْعَلِيمُ। यह नाम जिम्मेदारी, सुरक्षा, और देखभाल के अर्थ को प्रकट करता है।

in_pashto.name: راکب
in_pashto.meaning: راکب، حافظ، عالم، د الله ښکلي نومونو څخه يو
in_pashto.long_meaning: راکب د الله ښکلي نومونو څخه يو، چې معنی يې ده ساتونکی، څارونکی، او هر څه پوهونکی. دا نوم عربي اصل څخه دی او په قرآن کريم کې هم يې ذکر شوی دی، لکه: الرَّاقِبُ الْعَلِيمُ. دا نوم د مسؤلیت، حفاظت، او پاملرنې مفهوم څرګندوي.

in_english.name: Raakib
in_english.meaning: Watcher, observer, protector, one of Allah's beautiful names
in_english.long_meaning: Raakib is one of the beautiful names of Allah, meaning the watcher, observer, protector, and all-knowing. This name is derived from Arabic roots and is mentioned in the Quran, such as: الرَّاقِبُ الْعَلِيمُ. It signifies responsibility, protection, and vigilance, reflecting the attributes of divine care and supervision.

data.cultural_impact: The name Raakib holds a significant cultural impact in the Islamic world, as it embodies the values of companionship, support, and protection. In a social context, this name reflects the importance of strong relationships and community bonds within Islamic society. It also denotes a person who is reliable, trustworthy, and supportive during difficult times. In a familial context, it emphasizes the role of parents and elders as protectors and supporters of their loved ones.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Raakib carries profound meaning as it reminds individuals of their role as helpers and supporters of the Islamic community and the valiant against evil. It reinforces the strong connection between faith, service, and companionship. Raakib is also a reminder of Allah's unwavering support and protection, emphasizing the importance of maintaining a strong and unwavering faith in Allah. Ultimately, the name Raakib invites individuals to reflect on the essence of their role in their Islamic community and their role as Allah's helpers and defenders.

historical_references.reference: Al-Raakib was a companion of the Prophet Muhammad who was known for his generosity and hospitality. He was a prominent figure in the early Islamic community in Medina, and played an important role in the Battle of Hunayn (630 AD) by providing water for the Islamic army.
historical_references.context: Battle of Hunayn, early Islamic community in Medina

historical_references.reference: Al-Raakib ibn Abu Huzaifah was a scholar and teacher of Hadith in the 2nd century AH (8th-9th centuries AD). He studied under some of the most famous scholars of the time, including Imam Malik and Sufyan ibn Uyaynah. Al-Raakib is best known for his collection of Hadith, which was transmitted through the famous chain of narrators known as the 'Sahih Muslim'.
historical_references.context: Study of Hadith, prominent scholars of the time
